# Onboarding guide

Read the [security policy](https://example.com/security) before your first
deploy. Use `make check` locally.

## Steps

1. Clone the repository.
2. Install the tools:
   - uv
   - PostgreSQL

```bash
make setup
```

| Tool | Version |
|------|---------|
| uv | 0.9 |
| [Python](https://www.python.org) | 3.14 |
